items.title: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Security
items.summary: We're honored to share that Microsoft has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Security, for the second consecutive year.The post Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Security appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Rob Lefferts
